transcript.text: Hi everyone, I'm Mara, the Awards Producer. I've called us together because we need to finalize the presentation protocol for the Horizon Feature Award at Saturday's televised ceremony. The current draft rundown has the recipient using the south stairs, a 30-second stage cue, no broadcast delay, the festival sponsor wall as backdrop, and a 42-inch podium. Before I can lock the rundown and distribute it, festival production policy requires round-robin sign-off from four areas: stage management, broadcast standards, legal, and accessibility. I'd like to go around the room and get each of your reviews and any concerns so we can get this locked. Who'd like to start?
transcript.speaker: A1

transcript.text: I need to flag a critical issue before we sign off. During the final stage walk-through, I measured that the south stairs leave the recipient's camera path obstructed. The approved route is the north ramp, and the stage cue must be 90 seconds rather than the 30 seconds currently in the draft rundown. I have not entered these measurements into the master rundown yet.
transcript.speaker: A2

transcript.text: I have a critical broadcast standards concern. I confirmed with the network control room this afternoon that the Horizon Feature Award must run on a 10-second broadcast delay, with the acceptance microphone live through that delay. The current no-delay setting in the draft rundown is not approved. I have not updated the broadcast log yet, but this delay requirement must be reflected in the locked rundown before I can sign off.
transcript.speaker: A3

transcript.text: I have a critical legal concern. My review of the signed sponsor agreement found that the sponsor wall may not appear behind the Horizon Feature Award recipient. The backdrop must be the festival's neutral blue curtain, with no sponsor logo in that shot. I have not attached the clause to the ceremony file yet, but this requirement must be reflected in the locked rundown before I can sign off.
transcript.speaker: A4

transcript.text: I have an accessibility concern that must be reflected in the locked rundown. During the recipient's access rehearsal, I confirmed that the recipient uses a wheelchair and needs the podium lowered to exactly 36 inches — not the 42 inches currently in the draft. The accessibility plan must also record a north-ramp access accommodation. I have not yet added the rehearsal result to the production packet.
